report.title: Report a problem
report.description: Describe what is not working (you can also leave this empty and write it on GitHub). The next screen gives you a GitHub issue link carrying the BESTIN version, connection type, complex code and name, the last reply per device and recent errors. Passwords, IDs, IPs, coordinates, sessions and your unit number are hidden. BESTIN sends nothing: you review the text on GitHub and submit it yourself.
